structure.unit: Service Districts; Taxes and Assessments for Local Improvements

law.catch_line: Local ordinances related to business improvement and recruitment districts

text.section: After establishing a business improvement and recruitment district, a locality shall not decrease the level of publicly funded business services and business recruitment services in a business improvement and recruitment district existing prior to the creation of such district.

Nothing in this article shall be construed to prevent a locality from using the provisions of Article 1 (§ 15.2-2400 et seq.) to establish a business improvement district or business improvement and recruitment district.
